gaps.sentence: The museum is open to the public ___ appointment only.
___ the whole, the feedback was positive.
The proposal was rejected ___ a single vote.
gaps.explanation: 'by a single vote / by two goals' — the margin takes 'by'.

gaps.sentence: There is no harm ___ trying once more.
gaps.explanation: 'No harm in trying' = it costs nothing to try.'

gaps.sentence: The soldiers were ___ of danger once they had crossed the river.
gaps.explanation: 'Out of danger' = no longer at risk.

gaps.sentence: The two reports differ ___ several important respects.
Everything was packed ready in ___ of the movers' arrival.
By all ___ , the festival was a triumph this year.
gaps.explanation: 'By all accounts' = according to what people say.
